Size: 38,5 mm (diameter), 9,5 mm height, 48 mm lug-to-lug, 20 mm between lugs Case: Heritage Movement: Sellita SW200-1 - Standard finish, freq./h 28.800 (4Hz), 26 jewels, 38h power reserve Crystal: Double domed acrylic Water resistance: 5 atm / 50 m / 164 ft Strap: Black Leather Strap Warranty: 5 years Art and paint by Mythic Scandinavian Watch Art. About the Art S31 Spitfire Silver Swiss – Anniversary Edition Inspired by the iconic S31 Spitfire, this pilot watch pays tribute to Swedish aviation history and celebrates the 100th anniversary of the Swedish Air Force. Each watch features a hand-painted dial, designed and painted by Mythic Scandinavian Watch Art, depicting the legendary S31 Spitfire aircraft—Each dial is painted to order, making every piece unique. The design draws inspiration from pilot watches of the 1940s and 1950s, combined with details from the cockpit. Its slim 38.5 mm case reflects the smaller proportions of the era, offering a refined and versatile timepiece. The hands are inspired by cockpit gauges, while the classic bullseye dial with vertical brushing complements the flieger-style case with timeless balance and vintage design. The S31 was the Swedish designation for the British Supermarine Spitfire PR Mk XIX, the high-altitude reconnaissance version of the most famous fighter of the Second World War. Sweden purchased 50 aircraft from Britain in 1948, one of the largest export orders for the type. Unarmed and carrying cameras instead of guns, the S31 relied on speed and altitude. Its distinctive PRU Blue finish—a pale, sky-toned blue—was chosen to make the aircraft nearly invisible against the sky at high altitude. The S31 carried out reconnaissance missions during the early Cold War and photographed large parts of Sweden for civilian mapping. It remained in service until 1955, when it was replaced by the S 29C, the reconnaissance version of the J29 Tunnan.

About the Art ACE B 17 chronograph – Anniversary Edition Rooted in Swedish aviation heritage, this timepiece draws inspiration from the pioneering Swedish B 17 , the aircraft that marked the beginning of Sweden’s modern aircraft industry. First flown on 18 May 1940, the B 17 was Sweden's first domestically designed all-metal aircraft design. A total of 325 aircrafts were manufactured in its short active duty, as it was retired from frontline roles in 1948 and from secondary roles in 1954. Only a small number of of five B 17 aircrafts remain today and only one restored example is still airworthy, continuing to fly on special occasions as a living reminder of Sweden’s early aviation heritage. The aircraft is hand-painted on the ACE Chronograph 44, built for durability and readability and has become a fitting veteran amongst the MALM collections, suitable for the historic B 17.

About the Art J29 Tunnan Silver Swiss – Anniversary Edition Inspired by the iconic J29 Tunnan, this pilot watch pays tribute to Swedish aviation history and celebrates the 100th anniversary of the Swedish Air Force. Each watch features a hand-painted dial, designed and painted by Mythic Scandinavian Watch Art, depicting the legendary J29 Tunnan aircraft—Each dial is painted to order, making every piece unique. It remained in operation until 1976 and is today an important part of both Swedish and international aviation history.

watches.name: Dalton Blue White Panda Chronograph 41
watches.description: Inspired by Swedish aviation Free worldwide shipping 5 year warranty SPECIFICATIONS Case : 41 mm, Stainless steel, 316L. Silver Movement : Seiko VK63 meca-quartz. Chronograph complication Dial: Blue/White Crystal : Scratch proof sapphire, glareproofed, anti-fingerprint coating Water resistant : 10 atm / 100 meters / 328 feet Between lugs : 20 mm Warranty: 5 years Strap: Brown Classic Leather Strap ABOUT THE WATCH The Dalton collection is sprung out of the large heritage of Swedish aviation. Inspired by the authentic Swedish aircraft designs, the Dalton watch is a reference watch among Swedish pilot watches. The watch was originally designed for the 212th fighter jet squadron, callsign 'Dalton', and collects details and inspiration from the different Swedish fighter jets flown by the squadron throughout the years. It features several details inspired by Swedish aviation history. The numerals are designed to assemble the instruments and gauges in cockpit found in Swedish military aircrafts. The silhoutte of the JAS 39 Gripen is featured on the red center positioned chronograph second hand. The watch runs on a movement from Seiko called VK63 which is a combination of modern quartz technology and traditional mechanical engineering. Hour- minute and second hands runs on battery and the chronograph runs on mechanical parts with a 1/5 second sweeping hand. This hybrid movement makes the Dalton watch a very reliable, accurate and durable wristwatch. The top surface of the sapphire crystal has a coating protecting it from stains and fingerprints while the bottom surface has a double anti-reflective coating to create a clear and sharp visibility. The watch is waterproof to 10 atm / 100 meters with a screwed down crown. The left sub dial shows elapsed minutes and is synchronized with the center-positioned second hand showing elapsed seconds. The lower sub dial shows live seconds and the right sub dial the 24 hours of the day.

watches.name: Air Wolf Viggen Swiss Red Automatic
watches.description: Schweiziskt urverk; Sellita SW200-1 Monteras på beställning - leverans inom 5 vardagar Gratis frakt 5-års garanti Öppet köp 30 dagar efter leverans SPECIFIKATIONER Material: Rostfritt stål 316L, safirglas fram och bak Urtavla: Svart urtavala med Swiss Super-LumiNova C1 lysmassa i visare och index Storlek: 40 mm (diameter), 11,9 mm höjd, 49 mm lugg-till-lugg, 20 mm mellan luggar Boett: Air Wolf modell Urverk: Sellita SW200-1, frekv./h 28.800, 4hz, 26 juveler, 38h gångreserv, standard finish Glas: Safirglas, antireflektionsbehandlad med skyddande coating mot fingeravtryck Vattenresistens: 10atm / 100m / 328ft Band: Stållänk med premiumspänne / Black Classic Leather Garanti: 5 år OM VIGGENKLOCKAN Air Wolf Viggen är en tålig, automatisk bruksklocka. Boetten kombinerar inspiration från klassiska fliegerklockor med ett modernt uttryck hämtade från svenska stridsflyg. I klockans vridring, urtavla och visare finns detaljer från flygplansuret och mätinstrument som finns i SAAB 37 Viggens cockpit. Den lättrade ytan i boettens aluminiumcylinder återfinns i flera greppytor i flygplanets cockpit, exempelvis på Viggens styrspak. Viggenklockans utformning lämnar ett stort utrymme för en lättläst urtavla med svart botten och stora, tydliga visare och siffror. Index, siffror och visare är försedda Swiss Super-LumiNova C1 lysmassa som är vit i dagsljus och lyser grönt i mörker. Klockan har reptåligt safirglas både fram och bak vilket gör att man ser urverket i klockan klart och tydligt. Den inre roterande vridringen för tidhållning justeras med en extra krona placerad klockan 2. SWISS AUTOMATIC Air Wolf VIGGEN är den första klockan av MALM att introduceras med schweiziska automatiska urverk. Ett automatiskt urverk drivs inte av batteri utan har en rotor som vrider upp en fjäder när bäraren rör på armen. Urverket går att inspekteras genom safirglaset i baklocket. En automatisk klocka kräver viss fysisk aktivitet för att dras upp till max. När fjädern är maximalt uppvriden har klockan en så kallad gångreserv på 38 timmar. Urverket kan även vridas upp manuellt via den nedre kronan i klockan 4.
